title: Radon–Nikodym theorem via densities (Simon 3.24, with 3.13–3.15, 3.19, 3.21, 3.23)
statement: For a metric space X and outer measures μ, μ₀ on X that are Borel regular and open σ-finite, μ₀ with the Symmetric Vitali Property, and Θ(x) := limsup_{ρ↓0} μ(B_ρ(x))/μ₀(B_ρ(x)): (0) for μ₀-a.e. x the quotient converges to Θ(x); (i) if μ₀(E) = 0 ⇒ μ(E) = 0 for all E, then μ(A) = ∫_A Θ dμ₀ for every Borel A; (ii) there is a Borel Z with μ₀(Z) = 0 and μ(A) = ∫_A Θ dμ₀ + μ(Z ∩ A) for every Borel A; (iii) if μ also has the Symmetric Vitali Property, then Z_∞ := {x : the quotient tends to ∞} has μ₀(Z_∞) = 0 and μ(A) = ∫_A Θ dμ₀ + μ(Z_∞ ∩ A) for every Borel A.
